title: Input and output
description:
Write a program that asks for a name and a birth year with a `Scanner`, then greets the person and says how old they turn in 2026:

```
Name? Ada
Birth year? 1990
Hello, Ada!
In 2026 you turn 36.
```

The prompts are printed with `System.out.print` (no line break). The starter already reads the answers for you: `name` holds the name and `year` the birth year as a number (`Scanner`, variables and `Integer.parseInt` are explained in lessons 1.02 to 1.04). Your job is the output: add the print statements where the comments say.
hints: Build a line from pieces: `System.out.print` prints each piece without a line break, and a final `System.out.println("!")` ends the line. `System.out.print(name)` prints what the variable holds, not the word "name".
`System.out.print(2026 - year)` prints the result of the subtraction, just as `System.out.println(2 + 3)` prints 5.

examples.name: Ada
examples.expected:
Name? Birth year? Hello, Ada!
In 2026 you turn 36.

examples.name: a two-word name
examples.expected:
Name? Birth year? Hello, Grace Hopper!
In 2026 you turn 16.
